{{Short description|Russian mathematician}}
'''Victor Pavlovich Palamodov''', ([[Russian language|Russian]]: Виктор Павлович Паламодов; born 1938) is a Russian and Israeli mathematician, specializing in analysis.

Palamodov received from [[Moscow State University]] in 1959 his Russian candidate degree (Ph.D) under [[Georgiy Shilov]].<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=55993}}</ref> Palamodov then taught at Moscow State University. Later he taught at [[Tel Aviv University]].

Palamodov has done research on partial differential equations, integral geometry, and complex analysis in several variables (deformations of [[complex analytic space]]s).

In 1966 he was an Invited Speaker of the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in Moscow.<ref>{{cite book|editor=Aizerman, M. A.|author=Palamodov, V. P.|chapter=General properties of linear differential operators with constant coefficients|title=Thirty-one invited addresses at the International Congress of Mathematicians in Moscow in 1966|series=American Mathematical Society Translations, Series 2, Vol. 70|pages=180–184|publisher=American Mathematical Soc.|year=1968|isbn=9780821896457|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=3xQpXJ_hmBMC}}</ref>

==Selected publications==
*Linear Differential Operators with Constant Coefficients, Grundlehren der mathematischen Wissenschaften, vol. 168, Springer 1970
*Reconstructive Integral Geometry, Birkhäuser 2004
